note: Checked classification for merge-blocking, scheduled, and release-only evidence. Merge CI keeps deterministic witnesses; nightly/weekly keep sampled claims; tagged releases restore the complete slow/gate set.

jobs.claim: Classify the event and diff so required CI cannot silently omit evidence.
Typecheck all supported TypeScript/Vue surfaces and validate authored content/schema contracts.
Run the fast deterministic regression and operating/tooling/portability contract.
Prove the supported Windows tooling contract with the same typecheck/validate/fast commands.
Build/install/launch the supported iOS host: merge-blocking when native-host/toolchain inputs change, plus a broad nightly main-branch runtime smoke.
Run only the slow suites whose deterministic/stateful contracts still require this exact integration commit, packed into four duration-aware shards; the complete slow suite remains nightly.
Run registered simulation/content gates in their measured lanes.
jobs.moveBlockedBy: Use the gate inventory below; do not move a lane wholesale where claims are mixed.

jobs.claim: Warm the advisory run corpus for later runs; failure never changes correctness.
Publish one stable required verdict for pull_request and merge_group integration heads.
Build the signed Android release artifact for tags.
Build and verify the Windows release artifact for tags.
Tagged releases rerun every slow suite, including evidence moved to nightly cadence.
Tagged releases rerun every sampled gate moved off merge CI before packaging.
